This shortfall means the nation relies on foreign capital to finance the difference. Over time, persistent deficits can increase a country's foreign debt and weaken its currency.

final.background: A fiscal deficit occurs when a government spends more money than it earns from taxes and other revenues over a year. To cover this difference, the government typically borrows funds. Keeping this gap in check matters because excessive borrowing can burden future finances and fuel inflation.

final.background: Impostor syndrome is a psychological pattern where capable people doubt their own accomplishments and feel like frauds. Instead of acknowledging their skills, they often credit their success to luck or timing. final.background: A trade-effluent consent is an official permit that allows a business to release used industrial water into the public sewer system. Because this wastewater often contains chemicals or heavy waste, the permit sets strict limits on how much and what types can be drained. These controls protect sewer networks from damage and stop harmful pollution from entering the environment.
final.author_says: By law, water companies in England must accept industrial wastewater and grant permits known as trade-effluent consents that permit businesses to discharge it into sewage works, although water companies are able to reject applications.
